compute.cost_note: stdlib only (tokenization and counting); no spaCy, no API costs

do_not_use_when: you want habit vocabulary that recurs across many chapters (the leave-one-out baseline absorbs it; use manuscript_repetition_audit)
the manuscript has one chapter or the chapter markers do not match --chapter-pattern
you want a calibrated AI/human verdict; ratios are revision cues

examples.description: Chapter-distinctive words with project anchors excluded

inputs.target: a manuscript file split by --chapter-pattern (default '^#+\s*Chapter\s+\d+'), or a --chapter-dir of chapter files

purpose: Chapter-aware vocabulary distinctiveness. For each chapter, scores words over-represented against the rest of the manuscript (leave-one-out internal baseline) plus within-chapter clustering, surfacing thematic anchors, setting props and chapter-local habits. No external corpus required.
use_when: you want words distinctive to one chapter against the rest of the same manuscript
you have no external baseline corpus but want chapter-level repetition cues
pairing with manuscript_repetition_audit to separate chapter-local words from manuscript-wide habit vocabulary
